spans.s:
सैरन्ध्री, i. e. सीर + म्-धृ + अ + अ, f.
 1. A female artist, a [] female servant,

; Pañc. iii. d. 240.
 2. Epithet and name of Draupadī.

सैरिक, i. e. सीर + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to a plough.
 2. Having furrows.
 II. m.
 1. A ploughman.
 2. A plough-ox.

सैरिन्ध्र, for सैरन्ध्र, see सैरन्ध्री and cf. सौदामिनी,
 I. m.
 1. A menial servant.
 2. The son of a Dasyu by an Ayogava female,

.
 II. f. ध्री (cf. सैरन्ध्री), 1. A female servant.
 2. Draupadī.

सैरिभ (akin to सीर, cf. सैरिक), m.
 1. A buffalo.
 2. Indra's heaven.
